candidate.name: MCL Parity-Elasticity Two-Speed Relay
candidate.hypothesis: a tiny matched-MCL response finances orderly continuation, while a larger response at the same mature CL turn is an exhausted auction to fade

causal_seed.observation: one-to-two raw-turn parity ticks were direction-balanced and stress-positive overall; larger parity responses dominated v11 losses, while fixed global inversion changed sign across periods

lifecycle.raw_turn: close predecessor risk at the next MCL one-minute open; require direction-aligned 30-minute velocity and raw-turn MCL parity
lifecycle.maturation: after exactly one completed five-minute bar require retained macro state and renewed MCL parity in the raw direction
lifecycle.route: compare absolute raw-turn MCL response ticks with the frozen cell threshold; at or below follows the raw direction, above fades it
lifecycle.exit: close either speed on the next raw macro turn or contract roll
lifecycle.roll: remain flat until a fresh post-roll turn

bounded_cells.selection: the two-tick cell is primary; neighbors test local sensitivity and cannot replace it from exposed outcomes

prohibitions: no validation claim from the now-exposed suffix
no parity magnitude beyond the declared one-two-three tick neighborhood
no session, calendar, volatility, direction, news, stop, target, or timeout interaction
